visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled brown hair, wearing a black pinstriped blazer over a black t-shirt, stands in a dark-themed studio. He addresses the camera directly with expressive facial movements and hand gestures. Behind him, various blurred graphics and text are visible on the wall, suggesting an educational or news-like background environment. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a teppanyaki cooking surface. Sliced white onions and bits of meat are tossed by a chef using large metal spatulas. A yellow cartoon illustration of a surprised face is superimposed over the grill. The lighting is bright and focused on the food, highlighting the steam and textures. (3) A montage of Japanese cuisine follows, starting with a bubbling pot of sukiyaki containing beef, tofu, and scallions. This transitions to a plate of savory pancake topped with a fried egg. The man returns, speaking with a cartoon yellow figure on his shoulder, emphasizing his narrative points with broad arm movements. (4) A close-up of a thick steak searing on a hot grill is shown, with intense steam and sizzling juices visible. The camera then shows a black and white portrait of an older Japanese man, Rocky Aoki, with text identifying him. This is followed by an exterior view of a Benihana restaurant with its iconic red logo. (5) The man in the studio continues his explanation, now with dynamic manga-style action lines appearing around him for emphasis. He discusses financial charts shown in a screen capture. He then introduces a small, portable silver grill called MINIYAKI, which is shown on a table surrounded by food and drinks in a cozy indoor setting. (6) An animated sequence demonstrates the folding mechanism of the MINIYAKI grill, showing its compact nature. Hands are then seen placing the grill over a portable butane stove and cooking various items like burger patties and seafood. The man concludes by pointing downwards, likely towards a link, in the final studio shot.
